description: This file defines a class ADODB2_sqlite that extends ADODB_DataDict, providing database dictionary functionalities specifically for SQLite within the ADOdb PHP database abstraction library. It includes methods to determine data types, generate SQL suffixes for column definitions, and placeholders for alter, drop, and rename column operations.

classes.name: ADODB2_sqlite
classes.description: A data dictionary class for handling SQLite-specific SQL operations within the ADOdb PHP library.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Maps custom metadata types to actual SQLite data types based on given metadata.

methods.name: _createSuffix
methods.description: Generates the SQL suffix string for a column definition, including constraints like NOT NULL, DEFAULT, PRIMARY KEY, etc.

methods.name: AlterColumnSQL
methods.description: Stub method indicating native support for altering columns is not available in SQLite.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Stub method indicating native support for dropping columns is not available in SQLite.

methods.name: RenameColumnSQL
methods.description: Stub method indicating native support for renaming columns is not available in SQLite.
